channel.title: Rugspull Evidence Updates
channel.description: Dated, risk-first Rugspull evidence and operating-gate updates. Not live analytics, investment advice, an audit, or a safety signal.

item.title: Office Counter report 025 — 2026-07-19
item.description: Search Console accepted the 58-URL sitemap and reports 58 discovered pages. The new BNB Chain transaction-receipt guide is not indexed because Google cannot recognize the URL and has no referring sitemap or page; a priority indexing request was initiated. IndexNow accepted 69 URLs. Discovery and request activity do not prove indexing, ranking, clicks, approval, audit, adoption, or endorsement.

item.title: What is a transaction receipt on BNB Chain?

item.title: How to verify claims and refunds on BscScan

item.title: Why is the Opening price not below the initial pool price?

item.title: What does lifecycle-status monotonicity mean?

item.title: What does non-decreasing AMM k mean?

item.title: What does protocol fee destination mean?
